name: MTNYC_PlantedBlocks_20150930
description:
This dataset contains records of street segments in New York City where tree planting occurred, organized by planting season. Each row represents a street segment and includes identifiers for the physical segment and object, the street name, borough code, segment length, and several numeric codes that likely link to planting or block-level records. The planting season field covers 17 distinct seasons, with the most common being Spring 2012, Fall 2008, and Spring 2014. Borough codes indicate that most records fall in one borough (code 4, about 68% of rows), followed by code 1 (25%), with smaller shares in codes 5 and 2.

The data could be used to analyze the geographic and temporal distribution of street tree planting across the city, compare planting activity by borough or season, and examine how segment length relates to planting locations. It could also support urban forestry planning, environmental equity studies, or mapping of planting sites when joined with street or borough reference data.
